one_liner_zh: Okta獲利小幅超預期、營收年增逾11%，身分資安穩健成長但增速趨於溫和。
one_liner_en: Okta modestly beat with 11%+ revenue growth, showing steady identity-security growth that is moderating in pace.
beat_or_miss: 超預期：EPS 0.91美元優於預估0.85美元，意外幅度6.69%，營收年增11.19%。
ai_view_zh: 訊號中性偏正面：獲利超預期且營收穩健，但年增11%在資安族群中屬溫和，成長動能放緩值得留意。短期業績可支撐股價，惟86.18倍本益比下市場要求成長重新加速。中期關鍵在於新產品（如身分治理IGA、特權存取PAM）滲透、淨續約率與計費收入。建議追蹤大型客戶ARR、自由現金流利潤率與安全事件後的品牌信任修復，評估能否抵禦微軟競爭。
ai_view_en: Neutral-to-positive signal: an earnings beat with steady revenue, but 11% growth is moderate within security, so deceleration bears watching. Results support the stock near-term, yet at 86.18x PE the market wants growth to re-accelerate. Mid-term hinges on adoption of newer products (IGA, PAM), net retention, and billings. Track large-customer ARR, FCF margin, and post-incident brand-trust recovery to assess resilience against Microsoft's competition.
highlights_zh: 營收7.65億美元，年增11.19%，訂閱基礎穩固
EPS 0.91美元，優於預估0.85美元，意外幅度6.69%
身分與存取管理（IAM）需求結構性支撐
獲利能力改善，營運效率提升
本益比86.18倍，市場給予成長溢價
highlights_en: Revenue of $765.0M, up 11.19% YoY on a solid subscription base
EPS of $0.91 beat the $0.85 estimate, a 6.69% surprise
Structural support from identity and access management (IAM) demand
PE of 86.18x reflects a growth premium
risks_zh: 營收年增11%較資安同業偏溫和，成長動能放緩
Microsoft Entra等大廠在身分市場競爭壓力大
本益比86.18倍偏高，對成長放緩容忍度低
risks_en: 11% revenue growth is moderate versus security peers, signaling deceleration
Strong competition from Microsoft Entra and others in identity
PE of 86.18x is elevated, with low tolerance for slowing growth
